note: Anonymised design-system interpretations. Placeholder copy only — not the work of any named company.

items.name: ElevenLabs
items.label: Ink Works
items.blurb: A voice-AI brand whose marketing surfaces read like a quietly editorial print magazine.
notes: CTAs are subtle: a near-black ink pill is the primary, a transparent outline is the secondary.
The brand trusts atmospheric photography and modest type weights to do all of the brand work; there is no neon accent, no saturated CTA color, no developer-tools dark canvas.

items.name: HashiCorp
items.label: Ink Field
items.blurb: Cards live as charcoal surfaces with 1px translucent gray borders; product showcase cards lift into per-product chromatic gradients.

items.name: Ferrari
items.label: Ember Studio
items.blurb: A luxury-automotive brand whose marketing surfaces read as cinematic editorial.
notes: The brand's strongest visual signature is the **full-bleed cinematic hero photograph** that fills the viewport top with car photography, model details, or trackside livery — followed by a tighter editorial body layout below.

items.name: Apple
items.label: Cobalt Press
items.blurb: A photography-first interface that turns marketing into a museum gallery.
notes: UI chrome recedes so the product can speak — no decorative gradients, no shadows on chrome, only the one signature drop-shadow under product imagery resting on a surface.

items.name: Superhumon
items.label: Violet Field
items.blurb: a fast-email productivity brand split between an editorial dark hero (deep indigo navy with violet-sky atmospheric backdrop and a portrait subject) and a quiet white content body with off-warm-grey ink.
notes: The system uses a single proprietary variable display sans, heavy weight 460–540 with tight tracking, and a deep-teal closing CTA band that breaks the indigo/white rhythm with a warm dark interlude.

items.name: Coinbase
items.label: Cobalt Practice
items.blurb: An institutional-grade crypto exchange whose marketing surfaces read like a quietly-confident financial-services brand.

items.name: Bugatti
items.label: Chalk Field
items.blurb: An austere luxury-automotive interface that uses near-pure black canvas, white uppercase letterspaced display, and full-bleed automotive photography as the only voltage.

items.name: Replicate
items.label: Ember Works
items.blurb: The system reads as "AI lab notebook crossed with print magazine": cream and bone surfaces, dark ink type, monospace code wells, irregular hand-drawn-feeling diagrams, and a rich orange used scarcely on the most consequential CTA.
